title: Return Merchandise Form
subtitle: Return Merchandise Movement: captures actual activity and handoff.
description: Return Merchandise Form covers return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody. The returns coordinator records Return Merchandise Movement activity, quantities, variance, and handoff. Return Merchandise Form keeps Return Merchandise Movement exceptions visible until the returns coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Return Merchandise Form at customer location, return dock, carrier route, quarantine zone, and disposition point. Document return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody identity before Return Merchandise Movement begins. Compare return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody findings with stated Return Merchandise Movement criteria; route unresolved Return Merchandise Movement issues to returns disposition reviewer.

sections.title: Activity parties and source record
sections.guidance: For Return Merchandise Movement, identify responsible parties, customer location, return dock, carrier route, quarantine zone, and disposition point, and the linked return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody source.

fields.label: Item, serial, lot, quantity, and package

sections.title: Recorded quantities, results, and controls
sections.guidance: Capture Return Merchandise Movement facts for return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Return Merchandise Movement operating checks
items: Refund, replacement, repair, restock, or rejection routing

sections.title: Activity result and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Resolve open Return Merchandise Movement conditions; have returns coordinator assign the next Return Merchandise Movement owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Operating exceptions, holds, and retained evidence
items: Financial outcome requested before condition review
blocks.guidance: Pause Return Merchandise Movement when authorization, identity, safe handling, custody, or disposition remains unresolved. Retain the available Return Merchandise Movement proof and route unresolved return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody scope to returns coordinator.
